advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.title: Industrial Maintenance Technician
locations: FMS Estee Lauder Companies Inc. Bristol PA (980)
advancedtechnologyservices-advancedtechn.description: Founded in 1985, ATS is a company with a presence in the United States, Mexico and the United Kingdom. We are professionals in Industrial Maintenance and we make factories run better. Fundada en 1985, ATS es una empresa con presencia en los Estados Unidos, México y el Reino Unido. Somos profesionales en mantenimiento industrial y hacemos que las fábricas funcionen mejor. Principal Duties/Responsibilities: · Performs mid to expert level break-fix & preventative maintenance. This includes but is not limited to: observing devises in operation to location root cause of problem; dismantling devices to gain access to and remove defective parts; examining parts to detect imperfections; adjustment of functional parts of devices and control instruments; repair and/or replacement of defective parts; testing of device to observe performance; and performing tests for electrical circuitry and mechanical systems; reconditioning and repairing machine tools. · Identifies and sources parts, supplies and repair items as necessary. · Independently performs maintenance as per industry standards. · May be required to setup and operate multiple machining operations including but not limited to: lathe, drill press, grinder, and other metalworking tools to make and repair parts. May perform welding tasks. · Complies with 5S and housekeeping standards. · Drives and participates in CI activities - processes, results and cost savings. · Updates records and reviews CMMS history. · Troubleshoots and analyzes control systems to resolve software/ hardware and configuration problems. · Utilizes predictive maintenance technologies to collect equipment performance data. · Provides assistance to lower level technicians and leadership to small teams. Performs more advanced functions as a part of training and development. · Completes on-the-job and technical self-study programs for career development. · Follows all safety related policies, rules, regulations, technical instructions and guidelines. Situational awareness and identify unsafe behaviors and conditions. Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, & Behaviors Required: · High School Graduate or equivalent (GED). · Associates degree with a Technical focus and 3 years of related experience in general industry; or 5 years of related experience in general industry or successful completion of the ATS Technician Progression Program. · Understands electrical, mechanical, fluid power and control systems. Can analyze problems and perform repairs. · Must be able to use basic hand tools and specialized tools as appropriate · May be required to travel. Physical Demands and Working Conditions: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to stand; walk; use hands/fingers to handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb, ascend/descend or balance to heights that may require a ladder or lift; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl in confined spaces; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move more than 50 pounds. The employee is regularly required to use close vision and color vision. The employee is occasionally exposed to outside weather conditions and risk of electrical shock. Work is typically performed in a factory environment and is usually very loud. In the factory environment, the employee may be exposed to hazardous materials and/or greasy or slippery factory floors. ​ ATS believes in fair and equitable pay. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. We also offer market leading benefit programs including Medical, Dental and Vision plans, PTO, a 401k retirement plans with employer matching, tuition reimbursement, and more. capitalsolutionsgroup-capitalsolutionsgr.title: Sr. Cloud Security Engineer (NIN-AE4-18.062325)
capitalsolutionsgroup-capitalsolutionsgr.description: SECURITY CLEARANCE: TS/SCI with both Polygraphs is required POSITION: Sr. Cloud Security Engineer LCAT: Application Engineer, Level 4 REQUISITION: NIN-AE4-18.062325 LOCATION: Linthicum, Maryland OVERVIEW: Join our "Security in the Cloud" team dedicated to enhancing the security posture of our cloud environments. The team is responsible for developing and maintaining AWS service-specific guidance for handling Sensitive Data (SD) and Ultra-Sensitive Data (USD), ensuring compliance with specific handling requirements and caveats. The ideal candidate will possess a strong security engineering background, with experience in security frameworks and cloud security practices, and will contribute to process improvements and risk mitigation strategies. JOB DESCRIPTION: • Develop and document AWS service-specific guidance for managing Sensitive Data (SD) and Ultra-Sensitive Data (USD), including handling caveats and read-in procedures. • Review and interpret Risk Management Framework (RMF) guidelines applicable to on-premises and cloud environments. • Analyze existing on-premises security processes and translate them into cloud security best practices aligned with RMF standards. • Provide recommendations to government stakeholders on transitioning solutions from on-premises to cloud environments, ensuring compliance with security policies and frameworks. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement security controls and ensure secure cloud deployments. Assist in security assessments, audits, and continuous improvement initiatives related to cloud environments. • Keep abreast of evolving cloud security standards, AWS services, and relevant certifications. Required Qualifications: • Experience with Security in the Cloud, particularly AWS. Strong understanding of the Risk Management Framework (RMF) and its application to cloud transitions. • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. • Experience with secure data handling and classification. Knowledge of cloud security best practices and compliance standards. • Ability to work with government or research environments. Other technologies utilized: Python, Node.Js, YAML DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS: • AWS certifications (e.g., AWS Security Specialty, Solutions Architect, etc.) /////////////////////////////////// LCAT QUALIFICATIONS: CERTIFICATION: n/a EDUCATION: NOTE: Degree in computer science or IT computer engineering from an accredited college or university. PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE: • Master's Degree + 6 years, or • Bachelor's Degree + 8 years, or • Associates Degree + 10 years, or • No Degree + 12 years.

getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:934ef7d2-c77.title: Digital & Field Events Marketer
getwingapp-getwingapp:lever:934ef7d2-c77.description: Wing is seeking elite talent to join M32 AI (backed by top-tier Silicon Valley VCs), dedicated to building agentic AI for traditional service businesses. Think of it like a startup within a corporate: fast moving and agile, with the stability of a corporate, and zero bureaucracy. If you’re driven by challenge and eager to make a significant impact in a high-caliber role, this is the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. We're hiring a Field & Events Marketer to own our presence at industry events, tradeshows, and conferences across North America. You'll source the right shows, run them end to end, and be the person on the ground making sure every event drives real pipeline. This is a hands-on role for someone 1-4 years into their career who loves logistics, thrives in fast-paced environments, and gets a kick out of pulling off a great event. You'll partner closely with sales, marketing, and product to turn booth space and badge scans into meetings, opportunities, and closed revenue. Why This Role You'll own a high-visibility function from day one. Every event is a chance to shape how customers, prospects, and the industry see us. If you want to grow fast, take real ownership, and build a portfolio of events you're genuinely proud of, this is the seat for you.
responsibilities: Source and prioritize events. Research, evaluate, and recommend tradeshows, conferences, and industry events that align with our ICP and revenue goals. Own a rolling 12-month event calendar.
Negotiate and contract. Manage relationships with event organizers, vendors, and venues. Negotiate sponsorships, booth space, speaking slots, and add-ons to stretch every dollar.
Plan and execute end to end. Own every detail, including booth design and shipping, swag, collateral, lead capture, badge scanners, AV, catering, hotel blocks, and travel logistics for the team.
Be the on-site point of contact. Attend every event in person. Set up and tear down booths, troubleshoot in real time, and make sure our presence looks sharp from start to finish.
Prep the team. Brief attending team members on objectives, talking points, target accounts, and logistics. Make sure everyone knows where to be, when, and what to do.
Drive pipeline with sales. Partner with sales to book pre-show meetings, run dinners and customer events on-site, and ensure every lead is captured, qualified, and followed up on quickly.
Run pre- and post-event campaigns. Work with marketing on email outreach, landing pages, paid promotion, and social to drive booth traffic and meeting bookings before the show.
Own the budget. Manage event spend across the full calendar. Track costs, forecast accurately, flag risks early, and make smart trade-off decisions when priorities shift.
Define KPIs and report on results. Set clear KPIs for each event (leads, meetings, pipeline, ROI) and build clean post-event reports that show what worked, what didn't, and how to improve next time.

jobgether-jobgether:lever:24969df8-6eba-.title: Lead Engineer(Structural Analysis)
jobgether-jobgether:lever:24969df8-6eba-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Lead Engineer (Structural Analysis) based in India. This is an opportunity to contribute to the development of advanced aerospace products through rigorous structural engineering and analysis. You will perform static, vibration, thermal, and fatigue assessments of metallic aerospace structures using engineering fundamentals, hand calculations, and Finite Element Analysis (FEA). The role spans the full product development lifecycle, from design and validation through troubleshooting and field support. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers and global, cross-functional teams to solve complex technical challenges and deliver reliable engineering solutions. The position also offers exposure to aerospace standards, environmental qualification requirements, and customer-facing technical discussions. It is a hybrid role that combines technical depth, practical problem-solving, and opportunities for continued professional development. Perform static, vibration, thermal, and fatigue analyses of metallic aerospace structures using hand calculations and commercial FEA tools. Support structural engineering activities across the full product development lifecycle , including design, development, validation, qualification, and field troubleshooting. Conduct detailed engineering calculations and FEA studies to evaluate structural integrity, performance, and compliance. Apply aerospace engineering standards and DO-160G requirements when performing structural and environmental analyses. Investigate field observations and technical issues, perform root-cause analysis, and develop practical corrective solutions. Participate in design reviews, technical discussions, engineering presentations, and cross-functional problem-solving activities. Prepare accurate, clear, and technically robust engineering reports, analysis documentation, and supporting technical deliverables. Collaborate with internal engineering functions and external stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions within project schedules. Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering methods, processes, tools, and analysis practices. Support knowledge sharing and technical development within engineering teams while applying established methodologies and best practices. Where applicable, contribute to FEA automation and engineering productivity initiatives using programming and scripting technologies. Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related STEM/engineering discipline . Approximately 3–6 years of relevant experience performing structural analysis of metallic components, including static, vibration, thermal, and fatigue assessments. Strong hands-on experience with engineering hand calculations and Finite Element Analysis (FEA) . Experience with at least one commercial FEA platform, preferably ANSYS Workbench, ANSYS Icepak, or ANSYS Sherlock . Strong understanding of Strength of Materials , structural mechanics, and classical engineering analysis techniques. Practical knowledge of aerospace standards and DO-160G analysis requirements . Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to investigate complex technical issues, identify root causes, and develop effective solutions. Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to produce clear, accurate engineering documentation. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with confidence participating in technical reviews and collaborating with internal and external stakeholders. Demonstrated ownership, customer focus, attention to quality, and ability to deliver engineering work within defined timelines. Experience in aerospace, defense, automotive, or another complex engineering environment is advantageous. Exposure to FEA automation using Python, C/C++, C#, or Visual Studio .NET is a plus. jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec59e671-13ac-.title: Digital Marketing/Communications Specialist I
jobgether-jobgether:lever:ec59e671-13ac-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Digital Marketing/Communications Specialist I based in the United States. This remote role offers the opportunity to manage digital advertising strategies across search, social, display, and video channels. You will oversee a portfolio of client accounts, combining campaign execution, performance analysis, and strategic recommendations. The role is highly data-driven, with a strong focus on translating campaign results into actionable improvements. You will work closely with analytics, advertising operations, innovation, and sales teams in a collaborative environment. A key part of the position involves building trusted client relationships and communicating performance insights clearly and confidently. You will have the opportunity to deepen your expertise in leading digital advertising platforms and analytics tools. This is an ideal opportunity for an early-career digital marketer looking to grow within a fast-paced, client-focused environment. Develop and execute paid digital marketing campaigns across search engines, social media, display, and video advertising platforms. Tailor advertising content, messaging, and targeting strategies to specific audiences, platforms, and client objectives. Manage assigned client accounts, monitoring performance and making independent tactical decisions to improve campaign outcomes. Conduct keyword research, create and optimize advertisements, manage audience targeting, and track campaign performance. Analyze advertising data and translate performance results into actionable insights and strategic recommendations. Become proficient in analytics dashboards and campaign management systems to monitor effectiveness and identify optimization opportunities. Prepare monthly performance reports and lead strategic performance review consultations with clients through video meetings and email. Share cross-channel performance insights with clients, leadership, and internal stakeholders, highlighting audience responsiveness and campaign effectiveness. Troubleshoot advertising issues and coordinate with relevant teams to ensure timely resolution, strong client satisfaction, and account retention. Collaborate with Analytics, Innovation, Advertising Operations, and Sales teams to support campaign execution and new product opportunities. Maintain accurate records of client interactions, campaign optimizations, decisions, and recommendations in Salesforce. Monitor industry developments and competitor strategies to identify opportunities for improved digital marketing performance. Travel up to 5% as needed for client meetings or team events. Requirements: Bachelor's degree with less than 2 years of relevant experience, or approximately 4 years of relevant experience without a degree. 1–2 years of experience in digital advertising, SEM, paid social, display/video advertising, or a related digital marketing discipline. Strong understanding of search engine marketing, website and advertising analytics, digital content strategy, and paid media. Ability to understand client objectives and translate business goals into effective advertising recommendations. Experience with tools such as Google Ads, Google Analytics, Microsoft Ads, Meta Business Manager, Fluency's Backpack, and Salesforce/SFX. Google Search, Display, Shopping, and Microsoft Ads certifications are preferred and must be obtained within 90 days of hire if not already held. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and make informed decisions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly when presenting performance insights and recommendations to clients. Strong client relationship, time-management, organization, and email-management skills. Ability to manage multiple accounts and priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail.

matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:750053cb-5ac.title: Back-end Engineer, Trust & Safety (Go)
matchgroup-matchgroup:lever:750053cb-5ac.description: エウレカは、真剣にパートナーを見つけたいと考えている方に向けた恋活・婚活マッチングアプリ「Pairs（ペアーズ）」を運営している会社です。 Pairsは、日本国内で累計登録数2,700万以上の日本最大級のオンラインデーティングアプリです。2012年に日本版、2013年に台湾版、2025年に韓国版のサービス開始して以来、順調に成長を続け、70万人以上の方がPairsでお相手を見つけています。 2015年には、世界中でオンラインデーティングアプリを展開するMatch Groupにジョインし、私たちのミッションである「人生に”あってよかった”と思ってもらえるものを。」を実現するため、日本国内だけでなく、グローバルで更なる成長を目指しています。 Job Summary: UTH (Under The Hood) Backend TeamはPairs本体の機能開発を支えるマイクロサービス・関連コンポーネント等の基盤の提供や、アプリケーションセキュリティ・開発生産性・品質の改善などの遂行等を通して、堅牢で拡張性のある基盤を構築し、Pairsをより成長に導くことを目的にしています。 本ポジションは、UTH Backend Teamの一員として、Trust & Safetyプロジェクトに専任で携わるBackend Engineerのポジションです。 具体的な業務としては、違反ユーザーや悪質なユーザーに関するデータを継続的に確認・分析し、リスクや影響を評価しながら、必要な対策を高速に実装・改善を行うと共に、検知、予防、調査、対応といったTrust & Safety業務を支えるバックエンドシステムの設計・開発・運用を通じて、悪質な利用の抑止とユーザーの保護に貢献します。 また、Trust & Safety領域の関係者と密に連携し、現場で得られる知見やデータをもとに、対策の精度や運用効率を継続的に高めていくことが期待されます。 これらの取り組みを通じて、ユーザーがPairsを安心して利用できる環境づくりに貢献していただきます。 What You’ll Do: ・Trust & Safety領域における違反行為・悪質な利用・ポリシー違反などのリスク低減を目的とした仕組みの設計・Pairsへの適用・運用 ・ユーザー行動、システムログ、施策結果などのデータを自ら確認・分析し、リスクの兆候や傾向、課題の規模感、施策の有効性を評価 ・分析・評価結果をもとに、検知・予防・調査・対応といったTrust & Safety業務を支える仕組みを、変化するリスクパターンに合わせて継続的に改善 ・Trust & Safety領域の関係者、Data Analyst、プロダクトバックエンドチーム、SREチーム、セキュリティチームなどと連携し、品質、パフォーマンス、セキュリティ、運用性を高めながら、不正利用や悪用の抑止、ユーザー保護、Pairsの信頼性向上に貢献

summitwashholdings-summitwashholdings:le.description: IMPORTANT - REQUIRED NEXT STEP As part of our hiring process, all applicants are required to complete the Predictive Index (PI) Behavioral Assessment. The PI Behavioral Assessment is not a test, and there are no right or wrong answers. It helps us better understand your natural workplace preferences and behaviors. Please complete the assessment when prompted. Completion is required for your application to move forward in the review process. Benefits, and Perks - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Flexible scheduling - Paid Time Off (PTO) - Career Growth based on Performance and not Seniority – 75% of employees were promoted within Summit Wash Holdings - Referral Bonus up to $800.00 per qualified hire, dependent on position - Free Car Wash Membership Who are we? Summit Wash Holdings is a premier group of car wash brands growing throughout the Northeast, Midwest, and Southeast regions. At Summit Wash Holdings, all teammates produce speedy service in a fun and mutually respectful manner with gold-standard integrity, quality, and hospitality, all while maintaining a work-life balance. Our Mission is to provide a fast, quality car wash with friendly-spirited engagement and integrity. What do we need? The Entry Ride Operator is the conductor and entertainer for our members while making sure all vehicles are being processed safely and efficiently into the car wash tunnel. The Entry Ride Operator interacts with all customers and is responsible for exterior site cleanliness and creating a memorable experience in all interactions while preparing the vehicles prior to entering the car wash tunnel. A successful candidate would love working outdoors in all conditions and will be excited to roll up their sleeves to get the job done! You must be highly motivated, have an outgoing, and a friendly personality. We will provide extensive hands-on and online training for all team members. Location: Speeders Car Wash 3011 NJ-10 Morris Plains, NJ 07950

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:5d97e69c-0e1.description: Welo Data is an award-winning localization and data transformation company. We run one of the world’s largest Ads Rating Programs and we want you to join! As an Ads Quality Rater, you will review and grade internet advertisements to help shape how ads are delivered to the end users. In other words, you’ll tell the AI program how good or bad its advertisement suggestions are based on the user’s keywords. You will review ads in both English and Dutch This role is great for people who: - Surf the internet daily - Use major search engines frequently - Know what people want based on a few keywords - Enjoy researching topics online - Want a flexible and fun side job Project Details Job Title: Ads Quality Rater - Dutch (Belgium) Pay Rate: Based on tasks (approximately $16 per hour) Location: Remote/work from home - must be based in Belgium Hours: Set your schedule based on the following – Minimum commitment is 5 hours per week. You can choose to work up to 20 hours per week. Start Date: ASAP Employment Type: Independent Contractor/Freelance/Self-Employed Project Duration: Long-term Note: - Even though the position is WFH, you must reside in the country that is noted in this description. This will be automatically checked during the hiring process. Recruitment Process - There is no formal interview for this job! No phone calls, no waiting, and no wasting time wondering whether you got the job or not. - Instead, you will be guided through a self-paced and automated recruitment process. IMPORTANT NOTE: Welo Data uses numerous identity checks to ensure that everyone who makes the team is real, qualified, and ready to work. To avoid any misunderstandings, do not use IP masking programs (such as VPNs).
